title: THEIA: A Multimodal Dataset and Benchmark for Vision-Language Analysis of Layout
abstract: arXiv:2609.35035v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The integration of artificial intelligence into computer-aided design frameworks has sparked a shift in the design of analog integrated circuits (ICs), transitioning the field from using manual and algorithmic-based solutions to adopting automated and intelligent paradigms. In this scenario, the GDSII file represents the industry-standard database containing the ultimate and most accurate source of information of the analog circuit, encapsulating the complex physical geometries and parasitic realities that define tape out performance. This paper proposes THEIA, a novel dataset containing thousands of layout images paired with question-answer conversations, along with a benchmark that employs a fine-tuned vision-language model (VLM) to analyze GDSII files of analog circuits, enabling designers to interact with and query physical layouts as intuitive, meaningful entities. translated_title: THEIA：一个用于版图视觉-语言分析的多模态数据集与基准测试
translated_abstract: 人工智能与计算机辅助设计框架的融合引发了模拟集成电路（IC）设计领域的变革，使该领域从使用手动和基于算法的解决方案转向采用自动化和智能化的范式。在这一背景下，GDSII文件作为行业标准数据库，包含了模拟电路最终且最准确的信息来源，封装了决定流片性能的复杂物理几何结构与寄生效应等实际情况。本文提出了THEIA，这是一个包含数千张版图图像并配有问答对话的新型数据集，同时提出了一个采用微调视觉-语言模型（VLM）来分析模拟电路GDSII文件的基准测试，使设计人员能够将物理版图作为直观且有意义的实体进行交互和查询。基于数千个模拟设计的实验结果表明……
tldr: 本文提出THEIA多模态数据集与基准测试，利用微调的视觉-语言模型分析模拟电路的GDSII版图文件，使设计者能够通过对话方式直观地查询和交互物理版图。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes THEIA, a multimodal dataset and benchmark that employs a fine-tuned vision-language model to analyze GDSII layout files of analog circuits, enabling designers to interact with and query physical layouts as intuitive, meaningful entities.
